statement: The mixed Hodge structure on H∗(XB, Q) is Hodge–Tate. Under the nonabelian- Hodge identification, the class e has nonzero image in GrW 4 H2(XB, Q), and ei : GrW 2R−2i Hm (XB , Q) ∼ − − → GrW 2R+2i Hm+2i (XB , Q) (i ≥ 0). In particular, W2k = W2k+1 on this cohomology. These assertions concern the entire cohomology, including all nontrivial Γ-character summands after complexification.
